reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item: 0% vs the IC 5% rate, profit taxed only on distribution, the local cafe income outside the exemption, and a clear answer of 0 GEL for 2026 with caveats. B's distribution scenario is internally consistent: it taxes the 55,000 local profit at 15% and then applies 5% only to the net dividends. A grosses up 55,000 as if it were the net dividend and also applies 5% to the full 550,000, so its total is inflated. B also adds a useful point that the 5% dividend withholding is itself a likely source of the chat confusion, and it sets out the scenarios in a clearer table.

A: Scenario B grosses up the 55,000 local profit (55,000/0.85*0.15 ≈ 9,700) as though it were the net dividend, and applies 5% dividend tax to the full 550,000 without deducting the profit tax already paid, which overstates the total.
